name_zh: 诺贝尔/卡罗琳娜·克伦贝里/拉尔斯·马格努斯·埃里克森：发明-产业-电信三重螺旋创新生态
name_en: Nobel/Krumbach-Ericsson: Invention-Industry-Telecom Triple Helix Innovation Ecosystem
description_zh: 瑞典创新生态由三重螺旋跨百年共进：阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔 (1833-1896) 发明炸药/雷管，建立专利-资本-品牌三位一体模式，遗嘱设立诺贝尔奖将"发明"升维为"人类福祉"全球标准；卡罗琳娜·克伦贝里 (1920-2011) 与丈夫创立阿特拉斯·科普柯，将压缩空气技术转化为全球矿山/建筑标准设备，体现"发明→产业"转化；拉尔斯·马格努斯·埃里克森 (1900-1989) 创立爱立信，从电话机制造切入，构建全球电信基础设施帝国，实现"产业→基础设施"跃升。三者共同体现 M158 通才整合——跨物理/化学/机械/电气/商业/标准化的全谱系创新。核心机制：专利保护→资本再投资→全球标准制定→人才磁场→下一轮发明。
description_en: Swedish innovation ecosystem via triple helix across century: Alfred Nobel (1833-1896) invented dynamite/detonator, built patent-capital-brand trinity, will established Nobel Prizes elevating "invention" to "human welfare" global standard; Karin Krumbach (1920-2011) with husband built Atlas Copco, turned compressed air tech into global mining/construction standard equipment, embodying "invention→industry" conversion; Lars Magnus Ericsson (1900-1989) founded Ericsson, from telephone manufacturing to global telecom infrastructure empire, achieving "industry→infrastructure" leap. All three exemplify M158 Polymath Integration—full-spectrum innovation across physics/chemistry/mechanical/electrical/commerce/standardization. Core mechanism: patent protection → capital reinvestment → global standard setting → talent magnet → next invention cycle.
reason_zh: 瑞典非靠自然资源，以"发明-专利-资本-标准"闭环构建创新国家。三代人跨化学/机械/电气，展示 M158 通才整合与 M151 信任资本在商业生态中的指数级复利。
reason_en: Sweden without natural resources builds innovation nation via "invention-patent-capital-standard" closed loop. Three generations across chemistry/mechanical/electrical show M158 Polymath Integration & M151 Trust Capital exponential compounding in business ecosystems.
steps_zh: 发明专利化与资本化：诺贝尔 355 项专利，炸药垄断→全球军工/采矿供应链，财富锚定诺贝尔基金会
产业标准化与平台化：爱立信 AXE 数字交换机成全球标准，GSM/3G/4G/5G 标准制定主导权
人才磁场与知识溢出：皇家理工/乌普萨拉/隆德三大工科强校，斯德哥尔摩独角兽密度全球第二
信任资本制度化：斯德哥尔摩证券交易所透明度、瑞典专利局效率、三方协商模式延伸至创新政策
全球公共品输出：诺贝尔奖成科学最高荣誉、爱立信 5G 专利池许可、Atlas Copco 可持续生产力
steps_en: Invention patented & capitalized: Nobel 355 patents, dynamite monopoly → global military/mining supply chain, wealth anchored Nobel Foundation
Industry standardized & platformed: Ericsson AXE digital switch global standard, GSM/3G/4G/5G standard-setting leadership
Talent magnet & knowledge spillover: KTH/Uppsala/Lund three engineering powerhouses, Stockholm unicorn density global #2
Trust capital institutionalized: Stockholm Stock Exchange transparency, PRV efficiency, tripartite model extended to innovation policy
Global public goods output: Nobel Prize = science's highest honor; Ericsson 5G patent pool licensing; Atlas Copco sustainable productivity
expected_zh: 小国以"发明-专利-资本-标准"四位一体闭环，实现高值制造与全球规则制定权双赢，创新指数长期全球前三。
expected_en: Small nation via "invention-patent-capital-standard" quaternity closed loop achieves high-value manufacturing & global rule-setting dual win, innovation index consistently global top 3.
case_zh: 瑞典 2023 全球创新指数 #2；爱立信 5G 标准必要专利声明量全球前三；斯德哥尔摩人均独角兽仅次硅谷；诺贝尔奖 120+ 年零争议权威。
case_en: Sweden 2023 GII #2; Ericsson 5G SEP declarations global top 3; Stockholm unicorns per capita #2 after Silicon Valley; Nobel Prize 120+ years zero-controversy authority.
cross_cultural_impact: Nobel Prize global science governance; Ericsson telecom standards; Swedish triple helix model for innovation policy
spiritual_tradition: Lutheran stewardship + Wallenberg family industrial ethics
colonial_history: No colonies; Swedish East India Company 18th century trade only
diaspora_influence: Swedish-American 4M+ in US Midwest, shaped Minnesota politics/industry
indigenous_knowledge_system: Sami traditional knowledge in Arctic innovation (limited direct)
